title: PcnResponse
description: The response containing the Product Change Notifications

DigiKeyPartNumber.description: The product for which we are returning the change notifications.

ProductChangeNotifications.description: The list of change notifications for the requested product.

PcnChangeDate.description: The release date of the product change notification. Date is in ISO 8601.

PcnTypeId.description: The product change notification category id - this is included for easy sorting

PcnType.description: The product change notification type - in the language of the user (if available) - otherwise English

PcnDescription.description: A brief description of the change.

PcnLink.description: The link to the online pdf describing the change.
